nodes.title: POL-01 Beverage Equipment returns and approvals
nodes.text: POL-01 - Beverage Equipment returns and approvals. The return window for Beverage Equipment is 14 days from delivery. Orders exceeding $1,000 need sign-off by the Operations Director. Records must be kept 7 years. See [[SOP-01]] for handling steps.

nodes.title: POL-02 Cold Chain Reagents returns and approvals
nodes.text: Policy POL-02 governs Cold Chain Reagents returns and approvals. Customers may return Cold Chain Reagents within 21 days of delivery. Any single order above $2,500 requires written approval from the Quality Director. Return records are retained for 3 years. Handling follows [[SOP-02]].

nodes.title: POL-03 Industrial Adhesives returns and approvals
nodes.text: Policy POL-03 governs Industrial Adhesives returns and approvals. Customers may return Industrial Adhesives within 60 days of delivery. Any single order above $1,000 requires written approval from the Operations Director. Return records are retained for 10 years. Handling follows [[SOP-03]].

nodes.title: POL-04 Medical Consumables returns and approvals
nodes.text: POL-04 - Medical Consumables returns and approvals. The return window for Medical Consumables is 14 days from delivery. Orders exceeding $1,000 need sign-off by the Regional Manager. Records must be kept 5 years. See [[SOP-04]] for handling steps.

nodes.title: POL-05 Packaging Film returns and approvals
nodes.text: POL-05 - Packaging Film returns and approvals. The return window for Packaging Film is 60 days from delivery. Orders exceeding $10,000 need sign-off by the Quality Director. Records must be kept 3 years. See [[SOP-05]] for handling steps.

nodes.title: POL-06 Lab Glassware returns and approvals
nodes.text: POL-06 - Lab Glassware returns and approvals. The return window for Lab Glassware is 21 days from delivery. Orders exceeding $10,000 need sign-off by the Safety Officer. Records must be kept 10 years. See [[SOP-06]] for handling steps.

nodes.title: POL-07 Battery Modules returns and approvals
nodes.text: POL-07 - Battery Modules returns and approvals. The return window for Battery Modules is 45 days from delivery. Orders exceeding $10,000 need sign-off by the Quality Director. Records must be kept 7 years. See [[SOP-07]] for handling steps.

nodes.title: POL-08 Cleaning Solvents returns and approvals
nodes.text: Policy POL-08 governs Cleaning Solvents returns and approvals. Customers may return Cleaning Solvents within 21 days of delivery. Any single order above $7,500 requires written approval from the Regional Manager. Return records are retained for 7 years. Handling follows [[SOP-08]].

nodes.title: POL-09 Data retention
nodes.text: Policy POL-09 (Data retention). Operational logs are retained for 13 months and audit logs for 7 years. Personal data is never stored in raw form; it is redacted before persistence. Deletion requests are completed within 30 days by the Compliance Officer.

nodes.title: POL-10 Expense approval
nodes.text: Policy POL-10 (Expense approval). Expenses up to $500 are approved by the line manager. Expenses between $500 and $5,000 need the Finance Controller. Anything above $5,000 requires the Operations Director.

nodes.title: POL-11 Supplier onboarding
nodes.text: Policy POL-11 (Supplier onboarding). New suppliers complete a security questionnaire and a quality audit before first purchase. Onboarding takes at most 20 business days and is owned by the Quality Director. See [[SOP-10]].

nodes.title: POL-12 Incident reporting
nodes.text: Policy POL-12 (Incident reporting). Safety incidents must be reported within 4 hours. Reports go to the Safety Officer, who notifies the Regional Manager within 24 hours. Recalls follow [[SOP-05]].

nodes.title: SOP-01 Cold chain handling
nodes.text: SOP SOP-01: Cold chain handling. The procedure has 8 steps. Materials must be kept between 2°C and 8°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Safety Officer within 4 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-01]].

nodes.title: SOP-02 Hazardous material storage
nodes.text: SOP SOP-02: Hazardous material storage. The procedure has 9 steps. Materials must be kept between -5°C and 3°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Compliance Officer within 2 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-02]].

nodes.title: SOP-03 Receiving inspection
nodes.text: SOP SOP-03: Receiving inspection. The procedure has 7 steps. Materials must be kept between 2°C and 10°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Finance Controller within 8 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-03]].

nodes.title: SOP-04 Quarantine and release
nodes.text: SOP SOP-04: Quarantine and release. The procedure has 6 steps. Materials must be kept between -5°C and 1°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Operations Director within 8 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-04]].

nodes.title: SOP-05 Recall procedure
nodes.text: SOP SOP-05: Recall procedure. The procedure has 9 steps. Materials must be kept between -5°C and 3°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Safety Officer within 4 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-05]].

nodes.title: SOP-06 Cleanroom entry
nodes.text: SOP SOP-06: Cleanroom entry. The procedure has 7 steps. Materials must be kept between 2°C and 10°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Operations Director within 24 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-06]].

nodes.title: SOP-07 Battery storage
nodes.text: SOP SOP-07: Battery storage. The procedure has 6 steps. Materials must be kept between -20°C and -10°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Quality Director within 2 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-07]].

nodes.title: SOP-08 Solvent handling
nodes.text: SOP SOP-08: Solvent handling. The procedure has 6 steps. Materials must be kept between -20°C and -10°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Quality Director within 24 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-08]].

nodes.title: SOP-09 Data deletion
nodes.text: SOP SOP-09: Data deletion. The procedure has 9 steps. Materials must be kept between 5°C and 13°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Finance Controller within 12 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-09]].

nodes.title: SOP-10 Supplier audit
nodes.text: SOP SOP-10: Supplier audit. The procedure has 5 steps. Materials must be kept between -5°C and 5°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Operations Director within 24 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-10]].

nodes.title: SOP-11 Cycle counting
nodes.text: SOP SOP-11: Cycle counting. The procedure has 8 steps. Materials must be kept between 5°C and 15°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Safety Officer within 12 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-11]].

nodes.title: SOP-12 Damaged goods
nodes.text: SOP SOP-12: Damaged goods. The procedure has 5 steps. Materials must be kept between 10°C and 16°C throughout. Deviations are escalated to the Finance Controller within 2 hours. Governing policy: [[POL-12]].

nodes.title: ua.__init__
nodes.text: The Unreliable Assistant -> Enterprise Grade.

nodes.title: ua.agents
nodes.text: Deterministic reasoning components that sit behind swappable interfaces.

nodes.title: RuleBrain
nodes.text: Deterministic planner. Replace with an LLM-backed Brain exposing the same `plan`.

nodes.title: ChaosBrain
nodes.text: Adversarial brains for KPI-16 / Streamlit Tab 5: try to loop forever.

nodes.title: ua.api
nodes.text: FastAPI service: POST /api/v1/agent/query (+ HITL + admin/dev endpoints). Stateless workers; all state in Redis/DB.

nodes.title: ua.cache
nodes.text: Tenant-isolated semantic cache (ADR-003).

nodes.title: MemoryBackend
nodes.text: Thread-safe in-process backend with the same semantics as Redis (TTL, namespaces).

nodes.title: RedisBackend
nodes.text: Redis (Cluster-safe: every op touches keys sharing one `{tenant}` hash tag).

nodes.title: ua.config
nodes.text: Central configuration. Values mirror design.md; runbook knobs are mutable at runtime.

nodes.title: ua.contracts
nodes.text: Pydantic v2 MCP tool & data contracts (design.md 1.2). All models are strict + extra=forbid.

nodes.title: ua.embedder
nodes.text: Shared embedder: one query embedding per request (cache + triage + clause scoring + drift), memoised clause vectors.

nodes.title: ua.errors
nodes.text: JSON-RPC / MCP error codes (design.md 1.2).

nodes.title: Block
nodes.text: Raised by a plugin to block the request (fail-closed).

nodes.title: ua.graphify
nodes.text: Graphify: unified structural graph of Python modules/Pydantic schemas + Obsidian policy notes (Gate 17).

nodes.title: ua.harness
nodes.text: ToolExecutionHarness: every MCP tool call passes through

nodes.title: ua.loop
nodes.text: Bounded ReAct loop: deterministic state machine + goal anchoring + observation compression + dual memory.

nodes.title: GoalAnchorBlock
nodes.text: Immutable: original intent, normalised entity ids, active policy constraints. ALWAYS prompt index 0.

nodes.title: HotMemory
nodes.text: Sliding window of the last N ReAct turns per (tenant, session). In-process LRU: survives a Redis outage (FMEA #1).

nodes.title: ua.mcp_host
nodes.text: MCP host: JSON-RPC 2.0 client for the three MCP servers.

nodes.title: ua.orchestrator
nodes.text: Request orchestration: pre-hooks -> cache -> triage -> subagent ReAct loop -> verification -> audit -> egress.

nodes.title: ua.plugins.builtin
nodes.text: Built-in lifecycle plugins: pii_redactor, injection_shield, circuit_breaker, ragas_auditor, otel_exporter.

nodes.title: PiiRedactor
nodes.text: Regex + normalisation redactor. Replaces PII with typed tokens; never stores originals.

nodes.title: InjectionShield
nodes.text: Weighted rule classifier over normalised text + per-session crescendo accumulation.

nodes.title: CircuitBreakerPlugin
nodes.text: Trips on (tool_name, canonical_args_hash) failing >= max_identical_calls times.

nodes.title: RagasAuditor
nodes.text: Online gate = lexical claim-support (NLI proxy). Full RAGAS runs async/offline (ADR-006).

nodes.title: OtelExporter
nodes.text: Bridges recorded spans to the OTLP collector with a non-blocking batch processor.

nodes.title: ua.plugins.registry
nodes.text: Priority-ordered, hot-toggleable lifecycle plugin registry on top of pluggy.

nodes.title: ua.plugins.spec
nodes.text: Pluggy hook specifications for lifecycle plugins (design.md 1.2 'Plugin contract').

nodes.title: ua.rag.bm25
nodes.text: BM25Okapi with Porter stemming and an inverted index (pre-tokenised). k1/b adjustable at query time.

nodes.title: ua.rag.encoders
nodes.text: ONNX bi-encoder / cross-encoder wrappers + dependency-free fallbacks.

nodes.title: HashEncoder
nodes.text: Fallback: hashed word + char-trigram embedding. Lexical-ish, NOT semantic. Used only if no model files.

nodes.title: LexicalReranker
nodes.text: Fallback reranker: query-term coverage. NOT a neural cross-encoder.

nodes.title: MicroBatcher
nodes.text: Dynamic micro-batching across concurrent requests: batch <= 32, max_wait = 8 ms (design Gate 15).

nodes.title: ua.rag.engine
nodes.text: 3-stage hybrid retrieval engine (BM25 || dense -> RRF -> cross-encoder) with deterministic abstention.

nodes.title: ua.rag.guards
nodes.text: Deterministic grounding guards used by the retrieval engine.

nodes.title: ua.rag.index
nodes.text: Vault -> chunks -> BM25 + FAISS-HNSW index, with sha256 manifest (FMEA #11: refuse corrupt index).

nodes.title: ua.runbooks
nodes.text: Incident runbooks (Gate 10/11): alert rule -> automated mitigation. Every mitigation is reversible and recorded.

nodes.title: ua.runtime
nodes.text: Runtime assembly shared by the FastAPI service and the Streamlit workbench.

nodes.title: ua.security
nodes.text: HMAC-signed request metadata (tenant integrity across the MCP boundary) + signed server manifests (Gate 13).

nodes.title: ua.services
nodes.text: MCP server business logic. Shared by mcp_servers/*.py (real MCP transports) and the in-process transport.

nodes.title: ua.store
nodes.text: State store: session_facts, hash-chained audit log, HITL approvals, items.

nodes.title: ua.telemetry
nodes.text: W3C TraceContext, in-process span recorder, percentile tracking, optional OTLP export.

nodes.title: Recorder
nodes.text: Thread-safe rolling latency histograms + recent traces (bounded, drop-oldest).

nodes.title: ua.textnorm
nodes.text: Adversarial-text normalisation shared by PII redactor and injection shield.

nodes.title: ua.triage
nodes.text: Triage agent: distilled linear classifier over the (shared) bge bi-encoder query embedding, temperature 0 (argmax).

nodes.title: ua.verify
nodes.text: Lexical claim-to-evidence verification (NLI proxy, ADR-006).
